sloka: एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः ।आजघान दशग्रीवं रणे रामः समाहितः ।। ६.१०१.५८ ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā śitairbāṇaistaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।ājaghāna daśagrīvaṁ raṇe rāmaḥ samāhitaḥ ।। 6.101.58 ।।

translations.english: A tumultuous din arose of the arrows loosed by Rama and by Ravana clashing against one another.
